title: Require Active Rule Authority Ledger Identity Parity
forbids: identity drift between live Habitat rule manifests and the active rule-authority cleanup ledger
why: The active cleanup ledger gates rule mutation and must contain exactly one current row for every identity discovered by Habitat's canonical registry. This contextual check retires with that active ledger.
remediate: Classify every new or removed rule through the rule-authority workstream, update the canonical ledger and receipt in the same semantic layer, and do not infer a disposition from identity alone.
message: The active rule-authority cleanup ledger must remain in exact identity parity with Habitat's live registry.
